denominator_definition.title: Denominator Definition
denominator_definition.default: All non-null fact and source_claim finding IDs, including unsupported or uncited assertions. Unknowns, interpretations and hypotheses are excluded; their factual premises remain included.

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.default: Dated source observations, not independently established market truth. New means newly observed in this sample; gone requires an explicit first-party discontinued status.

count_definition.title: Count Definition
count_definition.default: One row per stable brand/product and field, not a count of launches, products, businesses or discontinued brands. All evidence is historical as of the selected reports.

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.default: Hypothesis about the sampled evidence; demand and commercial benefit are unproven.
